raw_download_manifest.license_status: Official page/README request citation; no explicit image redistribution or commercial license found. ImageNet image rights remain relevant.
raw_download_manifest.transport: Official download links use HTTP; local hashes identify bytes but are not publisher-signed integrity proofs.

scope: Independent Stanford breed benchmark. No adoption labels; no cat breeds or shelter-domain coverage guarantee. Oxford/Stanford label mapping needs review before joint model training.
duplicate_review: pHash <=6 candidate components isolated by test > validation > train priority; human review pending. Does not prove same-animal independence.
bbox_policy: Audited only. Full images used; invalid boxes do not silently crop data.
pixel_preprocessing: RGB EXIF transpose, fit inside 224x224 without upscaling small images, gray padding, JPEG quality 90; fixed train/validation/test transforms; augmentation left to model owner.
exact_pixel_label_conflict_interpretatio: The full image appears under different breed labels. Distinct annotated target boxes may explain this; it is not automatically a source annotation error. This full-image baseline quarantines such records.
official_test_comparability: 30 original test records excluded due to full-image label conflicts. The retained 8,550-image test cohort is a filtered benchmark and must not be presented as the complete official 8,580-image test.
